# Generated by tools/build_council_automation.py from CK3 1.20.1.1.
# Per-position monthly-check effects, built from the same restart hook text so county choice is identical.
# Do not edit by hand; rerun the tool after a game update.

# Root = the player. Moves the ticked Court Chaplain onto task_conversion when a county needs it.
ca_check_chaplain_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			ca_position_on_trigger = { KEY = chaplain }
			exists = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
			cp:councillor_court_chaplain = { NOT = { is_performing_council_task = task_conversion } }
		}
		save_scope_as = councillor_liege
		cp:councillor_court_chaplain = { save_scope_as = councillor }
		# Council Automation: start the same task on the next county, another faith before another rite
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:councillor_liege = {
					is_ai = no
					ca_position_on_trigger = { KEY = chaplain }
					any_sub_realm_county = { ca_can_target_task_conversion = yes }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:councillor_liege = {
						any_sub_realm_county = { ca_converts_faith_task_conversion = yes }
					}
				}
				ca_start_next_task = { TRIGGER = ca_converts_faith_task_conversion ORDER = county_opinion EVENT = council_automation.0001 }
			}
			else = {
				ca_start_next_task = { TRIGGER = ca_can_target_task_conversion ORDER = county_opinion EVENT = council_automation.0001 }
			}
		}
	}
}
